source.title: Caterpillar D6
source.quote: The Caterpillar D6 track-type tractor is a medium bulldozer manufactured by Caterpillar Inc. with a nominal operating weight of 18 short tons (16 t).

mass_kg.note: Stand-in: the nominal weight of one medium crawler (Caterpillar D6), used for a generic bulldozer because the Bulldozer article gives no figures. The same article gives 16-20 t depending on configuration. Range is the standard +/-10%.

size_m.note: size = D9 length x (mass_kg / D9 mass)^(1/3) = 8.1 m x (16,000 / 48,988)^(1/3), scaling a heavy dozer down to a medium one of the same shape. D9 figures from the Caterpillar D9 infobox (https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Caterpillar_D9&oldid=1382142968): "Length 26.5 ft (8.1 m)" and "Weight 108,000 lb (48,988 kg)". Low and high use the low and high mass.

top_speed_mps.note: Stand-in: 11.7 km/h = 3.25 m/s, the forward speed of a heavy crawler (infobox), used because no medium-dozer speed is published; crawlers of all sizes travel at similar speeds. Range is +/-25%.

attack_force_n.note: Ramming machine: attack_force_n = RAM_DAMAGE_PER_MOMENTUM x mass_kg x top_speed_mps / DAMAGE_PER_NEWTON (0.005 x 16,000 x 3.25 / 0.05). The engine works out the real hit from mass and speed. Low and high use the low and high mass and speed.

attacks_per_s.note: Ramming machine: RAM_ATTACKS_PER_S, the engine's fixed ramming rate.

endurance_s.note: No published operating range or fuel endurance found for this machine; category default (estimate 1 of 2).

aggression_0_1.note: aggression level M: operated to win, a machine with a driver.

group_tactics_0_1.note: group tactics level 1: works alone; bulldozers do not coordinate as a fighting unit.
